page.notes: Marginal notes are small and partly illegible; their wording is approximate. Note at line XI "Homo post quam facultates" is partly obscured. Right-margin note words such as "sapiens" and "erudi-tus" are the printed marginal glosses and may be imprecise. Faint stains at lower page are not transcribed.
